build_convtransformer_model: build a ConvTransformerModel for speech-to-text translation using the fairseq framework
build_convtransformer_encoder: build a ConvTransformerEncoder with conv subsampling and transformer layers for audio feature encoding
build_convtransformer_decoder: build a TransformerDecoderNoExtra for decoding encoder outputs into target tokens
configure_base_architecture: configure the base convtransformer architecture with default encoder and decoder hyperparameters
configure_espnet_architecture: configure the convtransformer_espnet architecture variant with 256-dim encoder and 12 layers
